title: Implement slugify with eight constraints
prompt: Implement slugify(input, options?) in src/slugify.ts. Requirements, all mandatory: (1) lowercase output; (2) strip accents ("Crème Brûlée" -> "creme-brulee"); (3) any run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes a single separator; (4) no leading or trailing separator; (5) options.separator overrides the default "-"; (6) options.maxLength truncates the result without leaving a trailing separator and without cutting a word in half when the word boundary is within the limit; (7) "&" becomes the word "and"; (8) an input that produces an empty slug throws TypeError("empty slug"). Do not add dependencies.
